name: Ability Activation

name: Ability Change
description: Changes or modifies a Pokémon's Ability

name: Access
description: Grants access to locations or features

name: Access Unlock
description: Unlocks access to new areas or game content

name: Accuracy Modifier
description: Modifies accuracy of moves targeting the holder

name: Audio Change
description: Changes in-game music or sound effects

name: Berry Growth
description: Affects Berry planting and growth mechanics

name: Berry Yield Boost
description: Increases the number of Berries harvested

name: Breeding
description: Affects Pokémon breeding mechanics or Egg production

name: Capture Modifier
description: Modifies capture mechanics based on ball type or conditions

name: Capture Rate Modifier
description: Modifies catch rate based on conditions

name: Catch Rate
description: Sets or modifies catch rate values

name: Catch Rate Boost
description: Boosts the chance of catching Pokémon

name: Catch Rate Modifier
description: Modifies catch rate under specific conditions

name: Crafting
description: Used as an ingredient in crafting

description: Material used to craft other items

name: Currency

name: Damage Reduction
description: Reduces damage from specific attack types

name: Damage Reflection
description: Reflects damage back to the attacker

name: Decoration

name: Decorative
description: Purely cosmetic with no functional effect

name: Duration Boost
description: Extends the duration of move effects

name: Evolution Trigger
description: Enables Mega Evolution or other form changes

name: Exchange
description: Can be exchanged for goods or services

name: Field
description: General field-use effect outside of battle

name: Flinch
description: May cause the target to flinch

name: Fling

name: Fling Block
description: Prevents the item from being flung

name: Forced Switch

name: Ingredient
description: Used as a cooking or crafting ingredient

name: Movement
